scope: Primary-reference reading; no donor implementation, reproduced timing or runtime acceptance

references.title: Lipschitz Pruning: Hierarchical Simplification of Primitive-Based SDFs
references.read: Author page, paper sections 3.3/3.4 and 6.1, publisher partial-update limitation
references.contribution: Equivalent regional expressions for supported hard/smooth CSG; relevant to discretization
references.limit: Partial pruning updates are future work. Far-field bounds do not supply exact samples. No Cubey speed prediction.

references.title: GPU-Driven Signed Distance Field Construction
references.read: Construction/culling discussion; dissertation section 3.3, PDF pages 24-32
references.contribution: Hierarchical edit dependencies, compact bricks, reduced evaluation work
references.limit: Reconstructs compact structure each modification; bounded field and D3D12/DXR implementation differ from Cubey. Published timings not adopted.

references.title: GPU-based clay simulation and ray-tracing tech in Claybook
references.read: World SDF representation and modification slides, PDF pages 8 and 20-22
references.contribution: Limited distance band permits local tile modifications using previous samples and temporary output
references.limit: Its distance-band/mip contract differs from unclamped Cubey R16F bricks; primitive bounds alone do not establish equivalent updates.

references.title: FidelityFX Brixelizer 1.0 manual
references.read: Low-level cascades, invalidation and updating from mesh geometry
references.contribution: Static storage reuse, explicit invalidation, brick lifecycle and traversal rebuild
references.limit: Triangle-input implementation is not an editable CSG donor.

references.title: Vulkan specification: Fundamentals and Images
references.read: Floating-Point Format Conversions; Image Writes / Texel Encode
references.contribution: Encoding/decoding and format conversion belong in native cache-equivalence checks
references.limit: Generic conversion rounding is not fixed to Python round-to-nearest-even. CPU probe is not a device-format qualification.

references.title: Vulkan synchronization guide
references.read: Synchronization responsibilities, validation and pipeline barriers
references.contribution: Explicit dependencies and reader lifetime are needed for coherent publication
references.limit: Queue/thread separation does not bound compute duration or rendering interference.
